_meta.source: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal (WB Data360, WB_CCKP)
_meta.notes: Observed per-country climate from WB Data360 (database WB_CCKP): mean annual temperature (TAS, °C) and total annual precipitation (PR, mm), annual series. We report the 1991-2020 baseline mean, the most-recent-10-year mean, observed warming (°C), and precipitation change (%). v24: switched from the cckpapi projection endpoints (which returned empty) to the Data360 observed series — more reliable and observed, not modeled. Covered 238 countries.
